visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a brightly lit tabletop displaying several Kansosan brand cosmetic boxes and bottles. Two small Totoro figurines and a miniature succulent plant are positioned among the products, creating a cute, lifestyle-oriented aesthetic against a white background. (2) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, dressed in a dark turtleneck and beige knit vest, appears. She uses a thin makeup brush to apply a light pink cream from a tube labeled 'Kansosan' onto her left cheek, maintaining a neutral expression. (3) She transitions to applying a liquid foundation, dabbing small amounts onto her face before blending them out with a larger brush. Multiple text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom and top of the frame describing the product functions. (4) The woman uses a soft, round powder puff to set her makeup, pressing it gently onto her forehead and cheeks. She then applies eyebrow pencil and lipstick, followed by a sequence of spraying a facial mist toward her face while her eyes are closed. (5) A final extreme close-up shot focuses on the woman's cheek and nose area, demonstrating the smooth texture of her makeup. A large brown nose prop is briefly held near her face for comparison. The video ends with a pink screen showing various social media icons and the website 'japanuts.com'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio sequence begins with a bright, percussive 'ding' bell sound, immediately followed by upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic background music led by a crisp guitar strumming pattern and a cheerful xylophone melody. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect occurs as the first makeup tube is squeezed, signaling a rhythmic transition. The music continues with a steady, driving drum beat in a major key. (3) A series of short, high-frequency 'swish' and 'tap' sound effects are layered over the music, synchronized with the visual application of foundation and powder. These effects are highly stylized and clean, with no ambient noise. (4) A rapid sequence of 'click' sound effects is heard as an eyebrow pencil is used, followed by a rhythmic 'psst-psst' sound of a spray bottle being discharged. (5) The music swells slightly in volume for the finale, maintaining a consistent bright and happy tone, and ends with a final musical flourish as the outro displays appear.
